item.description: She trained as a chemical engineer, cut her teeth at McKinsey, and went on to run grocery and retail for Uber Eats across Sub-Saharan Africa. Somewhere in the middle of all that, Cikida Gcali-Mabusela built LOURO, a South African luxury leather goods brand, crafted by French-trained master artisans.
